body: IDUNA commit 303dd7f. Zero new dependencies -- browser-native window.speechSynthesis API, reads the post body aloud, toggles to a Stop state while speaking, degrades gracefully on unsupported browsers. Backfilled all 70 existing posts via cmd/blog-rerender, not just future ones. Rebuilt and restarted the live iduna.service so future posts pick it up too -- verified healthy post-restart (health check + a real blog fetch). Closes BACKLOG S170-98.
title: TTS 'Listen' button on every blog post
